column1: # Changes tools/import-build-scripts.py makes to the build scripts it copies from ADP Monitor, so that no
# published file names a folder on the maintainer's Mac. Each replaces a default path with one relative to the
# script's own folder; behaviour on the build Mac is unchanged when the folders sit where ADP Monitor keeps them,
# and every one can still be set from the environment. The patterns are Python regular expressions written so
# that they do not contain the old paths themselves (this file is published too). The import fails if a pattern
# does not match exactly COUNT times; the replacement is used literally.
# Format (tab separated): engine  file  count  pattern  replacement  reason
